dublinCore.dc:title: 119 HR 10162 IH: Stormwater Treatment Optimization, Resilience, and Management With Academic Technological Expertise and Research Act
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Kennedy of New York (for himself, Mrs. Dingell, and Mr. Langworthy) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, and in addition to the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned

form.official-title: To extend the authorization for the centers of excellence for stormwater control infrastructure technologies and related matters, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Stormwater Treatment Optimization, Resilience, and Management With Academic Technological Expertise and Research Act or the STORMWATER Act.

subsection.header: Centers of excellence for stormwater control infrastructure technologies
subsection.text: Section 50217(b) of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (33 U.S.C. 1302f(b)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in paragraph (1)(A), by striking not less than 3, and not more than 5, centers and inserting 5 centers;
in paragraph (4), by striking fiscal years 2022 through 2026 and inserting fiscal years 2027 through 2031;
by redesignating paragraph (4) as paragraph (5); and
by inserting after paragraph (3) the following:
Of the centers established under paragraph (1)(A), 1 shall be located in, and focused on, the Great Lakes region.

subsection.text: Section 50217(e)(1) of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (33 U.S.C. 1302f(e)(1)) is amended by striking fiscal years 2022 through 2026 and inserting fiscal years 2027 through 2031.
